title: Performance Review
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office prepares for performance reviews led by Jan Levinson, who insists on professionalism despite her complicated past with Michael. Dwight tries to influence his and Jim's reviews with unusual tactics, while Jim plans to ask for a pay decrease. Michael struggles with the awkwardness of Jan's visit and their recent breakup, which affects the office atmosphere. The episode also features office gossip, a suggestion box meeting, and unresolved tensions about personal and professional boundaries.

main_threads.thread: Jan's visit for performance reviews creates tension due to her past relationship with Michael, leading to awkward interactions and a focus on professionalism.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Pam, could I see you in my office?
Michael: My boss is coming in today, the lovely Jan Levinson-Gould will, well, no Gould. The Gould has been swack, divorced.
Jan: No. No, we won't be discussing that, Michael. The only things I wanna talk about during your performance review are your concrete ideas to improve your branch.
Jan: I expect you to forget anything that you think may have happened between us and exhibit completely professional behavior.
Michael: I'm a little confused. 'Cause first it's all like kissy-kissy. And then it's like all regret.
Jan: I'm heading back to New York; Alan and I will conduct your performance review over the phone tomorrow.

main_threads.thread: Dwight's unusual approach to performance reviews includes trying to sell Jim a fitness orb, demanding a raise with a Superman reference, and arriving late to work.
